subject.title: fix: WebChat stop fails for WeChat channel sessions

question: Should this narrower selected-channel `/stop` fix land independently before or alongside the broader WebChat Stop recovery work in #92003?
rationale: The patch is focused and well-proven, but it changes abort targeting across hidden channel runs, reply-run registry state, and visible WebChat session selection.

options.title: Land the narrow fix now

options.title: Wait for broader recovery

options.title: Request owner smoke

recommendation.title: Land the narrow fix now
